_comment: ACTINV problem definition — HYPERION breeder activation at the qualified low-activation design alloy. Flux imported from the OpenMC statepoint; this file pins materials, schedule, normalization, and the 10 CFR 61 classification basis.

meta.title: HYPERION breeder — first wall / blanket / divertor activation & waste class
meta.alloy_design: Cr-Ti-V-W low-activation family (Ta-, Re-, Cu-, Mo-free); DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22645891

materials.note: Waste class is conditional on meeting this impurity spec (procurement/QA requirement).

nuclear_data.transport_and_depletion: ENDF/B-VIII.0 (full HDF5 library + full depletion chain)

shutdown_dose.quantity: decay-photon (gamma) source spectrum per region per cooling time, and a contact / surface dose-rate estimate
shutdown_dose.model: semi-infinite homogeneous slab self-dose: surface scalar flux phi_s(E)=S_v(E)/(2*mu(E)); ambient dose H=sum_E phi_s(E)*h(E)
shutdown_dose.mu: total photon attenuation coefficient (coherent+incoherent+photoelectric+pair) from ENDF/B-VIII.0 photon data, computed from the depleted composition (self-shielding)
shutdown_dose.dose_coefficients: ICRP-116 photon fluence-to-effective-dose, AP geometry (openmc.data.dose_coefficients default: data_source=icrp116, dose_quantity=effective)
shutdown_dose.photon_source_basis: photons/s per cm3 (specific/volume=1 basis), from mat.get_decay_photon_energy() on the depleted inventory
shutdown_dose.fidelity: first-order CONTACT/self-dose estimate; NOT a 3-D photon-transport dose map; assumes infinite uniform source with no geometric attenuation, ducts, streaming or shine
shutdown_dose.spectral_collapse: one-group cross sections collapsed from each region's own local spectrum (divertor uses the first-wall shape); blanket decay-photon source therefore reflects the softer local blanket spectrum

kronos_reference_results.waste_class: All components <= Class C at 100 yr, no GTCC; 100-yr Class-C index 0.06-0.17 (>=6x below boundary; blanket highest via Nb-94 in the softer local spectrum), robust across N 10-100 wppm
kronos_reference_results.condition: conditional on the impurity spec above
